intended_function: Improve material readability, miniature scale cues, and contrast between the human room and the miniature settlement through lighting only.
scope: Existing lights and WorldEnvironment settings in the live RoomScale scene. No standalone mesh or material asset is produced.
visual_target: Use a restrained warm directional key, cooler neutral fill, controlled pale-surface exposure, soft readable shadows, warm existing settlement lights, and a subdued cool exterior. Preserve object geometry, positions, silhouettes, materials, textures, and gameplay.
required_view_contexts: Photo-derived Room A overview at 330 inches
Room A, Room B, and photo-derived settlement views at 64 inches
implementation_constraints: Modify only existing DirectionalLight3D, OmniLight3D, and WorldEnvironment properties.
Do not add AO, reflections, lights, geometry, material colors, textures, or decals.
Do not reproduce generated image wall/floor texture or unsupported window-shaped shadows.
Keep RoomDefinitions, collisions, navigation, selection, interactions, citizen autonomy, and simulation unchanged.
